addr: 441, 8th Main Rd, 4th Block, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034 ph, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India

rev.t: This place has a good collection of jeans, casuals, semi formals & shoes. Most of the apparels are manufactured in-house, and are quite affordable, unlike the usual branded outlets.
Shop is permanently closed from 2025 and not sure of the new location. Thier tshirt quality is top class.

If you looking for good place for men's casual fashion, this place is worth to give a try. They have awesome collection to choose.
Nice experience.
